title: Kakidash MindMapData
description: JSON data format specification for Kakidash mind maps (getData / loadData).

nodeData.description: Root node of the mind map tree.

theme.description: Theme applied to the mind map.

selectedId.description: Primary selected node ID. Used as a fallback on load when selectedIds is omitted or empty.

selectedIds.description: List of currently selected node IDs (multi-selection). Takes precedence over selectedId on load.

direction.description: Reserved numeric direction field (set to 1 by XMindImporter; omitted on export and ignored on import).

linkData.description: Reserved field for future link or relationship data (currently unused).

NodeStyle.description: Inline CSS-like text and color styling applied to a node.

ImageSize.description: Natural or display image dimensions in pixels.

MindMapNodeData.description: Recursive representation of a single node in the mind map tree.

id.description: Unique identifier of the node within the mind map tree.

topic.description: Display text of the node. Empty string for image-only nodes.

root.description: Indicates whether this node is the root node (emitted as true only for the root node).

children.description: Child nodes in display order. Omitted on export when empty.

isFolded.description: Whether child nodes are currently collapsed (folded).

parentId.description: Reserved parent node ID. Not emitted on export and ignored on import.

thumbnail.description: Lightweight Base64 Data URL thumbnail image (hybrid image storage).

imageRef.description: Reference ID or filename pointing to the original high-resolution image in external storage.

image.description: Deprecated since v0.4.0. Embedded full-resolution Base64 Data URL image; automatically migrated to thumbnail and imageRef on loadData().

layoutSide.description: Preferred side relative to the root node when layout mode is 'Both'.

icon.description: Built-in SVG icon ID (e.g., 'check', 'num_1_blue') or fallback emoji/text string.

customWidth.description: Custom maximum node width in pixels, overriding the global maxNodeWidth option.
